title: ever LIORÉ|Plus Size V Neck Ribbon Waist Formal Evening Dress With Sleeves
descriptionHtml:
Shiny and sophisticated, indulge in this stunning?plus size formal evening dress with sleeves for your next special formal event. Short flutter sleeves and a plunging ruched v-neck exude elegance, along with a classic A-line silhouette. A luxe ribbon waist and sheer fabric overlay add a magical moment. Pair this plus size floor-length evening dress with heels or flats and your favorite jewelry.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Length: Floor length.

Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises sequin.

Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
